name: baseten-thinking
note: Upstream c1019d920 (Go dbc464d). thinkingFormat 'baseten' emits chat_template_args (NOT chat_template_kwargs) built from compat.chatTemplateArgs, plus reasoning_effort resolved through thinkingLevelMap. Covers $var thinking.enabled, $var thinking.effort, a literal scalar, and an omitWhenOff entry. chat_template_args is order-sensitive: it is fed to a chat template, so its key order is asserted, not just its contents. Shipped in pi-ai 0.84.2; backend flipped to dist (README rule).
